name: Hidden Acres Campground
note: Mostly seasonal: roughly half or more of its ~200 wooded sites hold seasonal campers' trailers, with nightly sites mixed in; RV-only (no tents), open April 15 - October 15, reservations by phone only. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: hiddenacrespa.com rates + rules/FAQ pages (read 2026-10-21): 2026 nightly rates by the day for 30A/50A W/E and W/E/S RV sites, phone booking with a one-night deposit, only a holiday-weekend 3-night minimum, most sites fit rigs to 40 ft, pull-throughs, RV/trailer only, season Apr 15-Oct 15, seasonal $2,800 separately ('not available at this time'); RV Life reviewers paid nightly $52/$54 in Oct 2026 (one 34-ft motorhome Jul 2024) -> real transient RV campground passing long-stay tests 2-5 (nights sold by phone with no application, no standing minimum, no site count published and pre-season imagery shows empty transient loops well over 1 in 10, no homes or lots sold); price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21: only water is two small stocked fishing ponds (~40x60 m and smaller) at 40.0331,-75.9069, north of the office. Esri Wayback 2023-04-09 leaf-off (z17/z18) and current 2025-06-25 imagery show the ponds ringed by trees and lawn by the houses/office, with the nearest RV loop ~85 m south behind a treeline; no pad at either shore. Default down -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.hiddenacrespa.com/rates (2026 season rates, valid Apr 15-Oct 15 2026, read 2026-10-21): 30 AMP W/E $52/day, 30A W/E/S $56; 50 AMP W/E $56, 50A W/E/S $65; covers family of 4 (1-2 adults + 2 children), extra adult $9/night; no mandatory resort fee; same per-day rate any day of week
booking_source: https://www.hiddenacrespa.com/rates (read 2026-10-21): 'Holiday weekends require a 3-night minimum stay'; one-night deposit on all reservations; no other minimum stated
flags: Seasonal share is an estimate: no site count splits seasonal from transient. Off-season Esri Wayback 2023-04-09 (pre-opening) shows roughly 80-110 stored trailers across the ~200-site park (RV Life count), with the NW gravel loops near the office empty; an RV Life reviewer (Jul 2024) saw 'more than half nice seasonal tenants', another (May 2024) 'a nice mix of seasonal vs weekend trippers'. Transient share looks well above 1 in 10.

Booking is phone only (no online engine); the operator site carries current 2026 rates and two phones (610-857-0662 is after-hours/off-season), satisfying the presence rule. Google: 4.4 from 166 reviews.
